title: Feature request
summary: Move a request from user need through product choice and delivery evidence.
entryConditions: A request, user problem, or opportunity is captured
steps: Clarify actor, problem, and desired outcome
When the request spans multiple stories, define product requirements and a story map before story drafting
Define scope, exclusions, and acceptance examples
Assess product and technical options; record architecture and coding-standard catalogs when design choices apply

Plan criterion-linked tests and verification: use the repository end-to-end runner or Playwright for changed browser journeys, frontend-acceptance for visual criteria, and integration tests for changed system boundaries
Deliver, verify, accept, and evaluate the outcome
outputs: Architecture and coding-standard catalogs when applicable
